paper_basis.applied_to: payment, refund, item delivery, and gacha log based structured reasoning

paper_basis.name: ChatLR: Redefining Information Retrieval of Structured Database via LLMs
paper_basis.applied_to: structured database retrieval and log lookup cases

paper_basis.name: Enhancing Few-shot Text-to-SQL Capabilities of LLMs
paper_basis.applied_to: date, status, and condition-constrained database query cases
